data.title: tl;dv (Too Lazy; Didn't Validate): 181,874 Meetings Left Wide Open
data.description: How a missing Firestore security rule on tl;dv exposed 181,874 meetings from 84,312 users across 35,003 domains, including live calls I could join uninvited, and how six months of disclosure got me nothing but seen receipts.
data.author: BobDaHacker
data.keywords: security, tldv, vulnerability, responsible disclosure, firebase, firestore, data exposure, security research, tenant isolation, api security, meeting privacy
